tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gur rigs bsdus kyi dbang gi mtshams sbyor bzhugs so// bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i/ /sku lnga'i bdag nyid rgyal ba lngar/ /btud nas de yi dkyil 'khor du/ /smin byed dbang gi mtshams sbyor bri/ /gur rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams kun mkhyen go rams pa'i mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil shar pa'i mchod phreng rje dkon mchog lhun grub dang / paṇa chen thar rtse nas kyis mdzad pa'i zur 'debs sogs kyi steng nas cho ga dag par bya zhing / slob ma rnams khrus byas me tog bkye bsdu grub rjes slob dpon gyi zang zing za mi blta ba'i bstan pa dang slob ma la phan 'dod kyi snying rjes kun nas bslangs te/ sems bskyed gsal btab pa nas bzung ste kyai rdor dbang bshad gzhir bzhag las/ 'dir kyai rdo rje'i bshad rgyud thun mong ma yin pa'i rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las gsungs pa'i mkha' 'gro lnga rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba la spyir dbang bskur ba thob pa'i phan yon sogs chos bcu gsum phal cher kyai rdor dang 'dra zhing khyad par rnams dkyil chog bzhin la bcu gcig pa phyir mi ldog par bya ba'i phyir chos zab mo bshad pas spro ba bskyed pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ bdag nyid chen po sogs/ de'i don ni/ zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i snod du gyur pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis rnyed pa'i mchog legs par rnyed cing / rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis mkhyen brtse nus pas yongs su bzung ste/ de'i rigs su skye bzhin par gyur pas na theg chen gyi lam mchog du gyur pa 'di la brten nas myur du 'jig rten gyi gnas lugs mngon sum du gzigs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten gyi mchod pa'i gnas nyid du gyur pa/ de lta bu'i go 'phang de yang rang gi ngo bo bden gnyis zung 'jug yin zhing rtogs byed kyi thabs kyang bden pa gnyis kyis gsal bar byas pa yin te/

yod pa dang med pa la sogs pa'i mtha' gnyis las 'das pa/ dpe nam mkha' bzhin du dri ma med pa'i chos kyi dbyings ni zab mo ste/ rtog pa thams cad kyis mi rtogs shing / skye 'gag dang gnas pa med pas spros pa kun dang bral ba ni don dam pa'i bden pa yin la/ spros bral de'i ngang nas spros pa yod par spros pa ste rten 'brel gyi snang ba sna tshogs su snang ba rnams brtags pa'i las dang bya ba la sogs pa'i rtog pa dang bral ba ni kun rdzob kyi bden pa ste de ltar bden pa gnyis zung 'jug tu ston pa ni theg pa mchog gi tshul 'di la gnas na thob par 'gyur/ zhes pa yin/ gzhan rnams 'dra/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i brda sprod ni/ sems bskyed gsal 'debs sogs 'dra zhing / dga' chen khyod bdag sogs kyi mjug tu/ de ltar khyed rnams kyi slob dpon la gsol ba btab nas khyed rnams kyi dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa'i phyir slob dpon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la gsol ba btab cing gnang ba zhu ba ni/ rnam dag slob ma 'di rnams ni sogs/ zhes pa'i don ni thun mong gi sbyang bas rgyud rnam par dag pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i byang chub kyi sems zung du 'jug pa'i rang bzhin 'dzin zhing / gsang ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs nas dam tshig dang sdom ba'i tshogs rnams nod par 'tshal na/ de bzhin du gnang bar mdzad du gsol zhes pa ni/ de nas khyed rnams gsang ba'i dam tshig 'dzin pa la spro'am/ zhes pa dri ba ni gsang ba sogs/ zhes pa'i don ni/ gsang ba chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gnyis su ye shes kyi rigs te/ rgyu rnam par dag pa gsang ba'i ngo bo dam tshig dang sdom pa yongs su 'dzin par bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod la/ zhes pa yin pas khyed rnams kyis kyang ji ltar dris pa de ltar spro'o/ /zhes lan btab par mos pa 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ gsang ba sogs so/ /khyed rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/

mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying khar hūm̐ sngon po rnams gsal btab nas/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyang bar mos te/ de nas slob dpon gyi oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ khyod su yin sogs nas/ yum swā hā zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de rnams phyi'i 'jug pa yin/ de nas nang du 'jug pa la chos gsum gyi dang po/ lus 'bul ba'i slad du khyed rnams skad cig gis rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku gsal btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa'i phyir dang / slob dpon go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir dang / sems can thams cad yongs su bskyabs pa'i phyir du bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la gus pas dbul bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba bud+dha sogs/ gzhan dkyil chog bzhin/ rig pa'i dbang lnga'i skabs bshad pas cung zad byed na/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa'i sogs kyi mjug tu/ tshig rkang dang pos de bzhin gshegs pa gshegs ma/ gnyis pas khro bo khro mo/ /gsum pas sems dpa' sems ma rnams la gsol ba btab pas/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor ba rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo lnga po he ru ka zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa'i rnam pa can du gyur nas/ phyag bcu drug po thams cad kyi bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i gang ba re re thogs te slob dpon dang lhan cig pas/ khyed rnams kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ phung po lnga de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blangs pas khams bzhi yum bzhi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bkra shis brjod pas/ nang gi skye mched drug byang chub sems dpa' drug lha mo rnams kyi mchod pas phyi'i skye mched drug lha mo drug

khro bo rnams kyi bgegs bskrad pas tshigs chen bcu khro bo bcur sogs rtogs bskyed kyi 'jug tu de la mi bskyod pa dang chu dbang sbyar ba ni/ mi bskyod pa thugs kyi ngo bo byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin yin pa ltar/ rgyud las kyang / gang phyir byang sems gsher ba nyid/ /gsher ba chu yi khams su brjod/ /chu ni mi bskyod gzugs kyi phyir/ /zhe sdang 'dren pa mi bskyod pa/ /zhes bde ba'i rten byang sems gsher ba'i ngo bo mi bskyod pa yin par gsungs shing / mi bskyod pa ni thams cad kyi gtso bo yin pa ltar/ bum pa'i chu yang dbang rdzas kyi gtso bo yin la/ sbyang gzhi rnam shes kyi phung po las nyon gyi bag chags bgo ba'i rten yin pa ltar ram/ yang na 'phags pa lhas chos rnams sngon du yid 'gro te/ /yid gtso yid kyis 'gros can yin/ /zhes ba ltar sbyang gzhi'i gtso bor 'khor bar skye ba len pa po rnam shes yin pas de sbyang byed chos dbyings ye shes sbyar ba'ang yong ba la yang sbyang 'bras me long ye shes kyang / mdo sde rgyan las/ me long ye shes mi g.yo ste/ /ye shes gsum ni de la rten/ /zhes ye shes gzhan gyi rten byed bar gsungs shing / sbyang bya zhe sdang skyes na kha dog nag po ltar/ sbyong byed mi bskyod pa yang sku mdog nag por 'byung ba lags/ de bzhin du rin 'byung dang cod paṇa sbyar ba ni/ rin 'byung sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gyi ngo bo gdul bya'i bsam pa 'gengs par byed pa yin/ zag med sbyang gzhi tshor ba bde sdug myang bas yul la blang dor byed pa/ sbyang 'bras mnyam nyid ye shes kyi 'khor ba mi stong zhing myang 'das la mi gnas la/ sbyang bya nga rgyal dang ser sna longs spyod la brten nas 'byung zhing / longs spyod kyi gtso bo rin po che 'od gsal ba ltar rin 'byung sku mdog ser po 'byung ba lags/ 'od dpag med dang rdo rje sbyor ba ni/

'od dpag med sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi ngo bo yin pa ltar rdo rje rtse dgu pas kyang bshad bya'i chos gsung rab yan lag dgu mtshon zhing / rtse dgu ni/ gur las/ rdo rje chen po rtse dgu pa/ /zhes pa'i don/ rdo rje rtse lnga'i steng 'og gi ra thal byung du yod pa gur 'grel las bshad cing gsung rab yan lag dgu'i tha snyad kyang bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa las 'byung / sbyang gzhi 'du shes kyi yul la mtshan mar bzung nas spu ris so sor 'byed pa ltar/ sbyang 'bras so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyang chos can thams cad ma 'dres par so sor mkhyen la/ sbyang bya 'dod chags skyes na kha dog dmar ba ltar/ 'od dpag med kyang sku mdog dmar por 'byung lags/ don grub dang dril bu sbyar ba ni don grub sangs rgyas kyi phrin las kyi ngo bo yin pas/ phrin las kyi gtso bo gdul bya chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong ba la sbyor bar mdzad pa ltar dril bu'i sgras kyang skye 'gag dang bral ba'i don ston pa dga' ba stong pa dang sher phyin gyi zhal gyi chos nyid rang bzhin gyi stong par rtogs pas mtshon zhing / sbyang gzhi 'du byed kyi yul 'dus byas nas rang don grub pa'i gnyen por bya grub ye shes kyi sems can gyis don 'grub la sbyang bya phrag dog nyon mongs pa kun ldan yin pa ltar don grub kyang kha dog kun ldan ljang khur 'byung ba lags/ rnam snang dang ming dbang sbyar ba ni/ rnam snang sangs rgyas kyi sku yin pas/ gdul byas mtshon bla zhing / lung ston pa la sogs pa yin pa ltar/ mnyam sbyor las/ rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur ba/ /de bzhin gshegs par de lung bstan/ /zhes 'byung ba lags shing / sbyang gzhi gzugs phung ni shes pa la der snang ba tsam las don gzhan du med par ltar/ sbyang 'bras chos dbyings ye shes kyang ye shes chos kyi dbyings dang / dbyer med pa la ye shes su bshad/ ces la ltar ye shes las don gzhan pa'i dbyings ma grub cing /

sbyang bya gti mug gang du'ang bsgyur du 'dod pa ltar ram/ yang na me long nga yir med zhes pa'i tshul gyis me long yang sbyor la/ rnam snang sku mdog dkar por 'byung ba lags/ dbang de rnams kyi don sogs/ 'di rnams so sor ram stabs gcig 'chad pa gang bde'o/ /gzhan 'dra/ rigs lnga'i sprul bshad ni ji ltar sogs/ de'i don ni thabs kyis bye brag ji lta bu'i tshul ji ltar 'dul ba'i 'gyur ba legs par rtogs nas/ thabs de lta bu dang tshul de ltar sems can gyi don bya dgos pas/ thabs gtsang ba ni dag pa ste/ dug lnga gang dang gang 'brel ba/ de dang rjes su mthun par bstan nas gnas skabs dang mthar thugs gi 'bras bu la sbyor bar gyis shig ces pa'i don yin pas khyed rang rnams de bzhin gshegs pa rnam snang la sogs pa'i nga rgyal du rim par 'phos nas phyag rgya rnams kyi lad mo mdzod/ 'jig rten kun la sogs/ 'bras bu'i dbugs dbyung ba ni/ mchog tu gsang ba'i sogs/ de'i don ni mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir khyed rnams cho ga'i sgo nas btsud cing mthong bas na sdig pa dang sdug bsngal kun las rnam par grol te/ bde ba'i legs pa'i 'bras bu bde ba chen po'i theg pa 'dir btsud nas/ phyin chad srid pa'i sdug bsngal skye ba dang / 'chi ba med pas bdud dang bar du gcod pa gang gis kyang mi tshugs shing mi chud pas cis kyang 'jigs pa med pa'i smin grol gyi lam 'di la dga' bar gyis shig de ltar srid pa shin tu dag pa sku bzhi'i 'byor pa thob nas/ gdul bya 'khor ba dang ngan song gi srid pa las ston pa'i mchog tu 'gyur ba yin zhes pa'o/ /gzhan rgyas pa kyai rdor dbang bshad ltar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi brjed tho'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ gur rigs bsdus kyi dbang gi mtshams sbyor/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
